raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that all beach animals universally require salt water and dismissed producers because many animals don’t eat them directly. In ecology, all animals depend (directly or indirectly) on producers as the base of the food web, while many beach animals (e.g., shorebirds, terrestrial insects/mammals) do not require salt water to survive.
